verdict.rationale: Jules is a cloud-hosted coding agent that runs tasks in virtual machines, so data residency and region selection is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack, first-party or community, mentions choosing a storage region or residency location. The cloud-VM evidence describes where code executes, not a user-selectable residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
